image_description: A night-time photograph showing a woman holding a hammerhead shark vertically by its cephalofoil (head). The shark's ventral side (white belly) is facing the camera. In the background, there are other people on what appears to be a boat deck, illuminated by artificial light against a dark background.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject clearly displays the iconic T-shaped head structure characteristic of hammerhead sharks.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned at the extreme lateral tips of the cephalofoil.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows the ventral (underbelly) view of the shark. Eyes are located on the dorsal (top) surface and are not visible from this angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Small indentations consistent with nostril placement are visible on the underside of the cephalofoil arms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Caudal fin is asymmetrical with a pronounced upper lobe.
